scope: Direct inspection of both cleared full sources and source-coordinate detail plots. No camera/model/app edits or accepted image-match claim.
coordinate_convention: Original full-page pixels, origin upper left. Analytical viewports retain source coordinates. Readings are approximate observations, not fitted control points.

priorities.observed: Broad continuous stone apron spans central bay. Concave shoulders rise around the central oculus hood. Square end pedestals carry urn-like finials; central ornament rises higher. It is not a floating ring.
priorities.action: Keep current oculus center initially. Build continuous apron, concave shoulders and nested edge molding; compare actual silhouette before changing roof height.

priorities.observed: Tall molded keystones/crowns, particularly central, with shouldered or curled sides and nested surrounds. Current short rectangular pins are visibly insufficient.
priorities.metric_limit: Relative pictured heights scaled by reported9.144m aperture, not a survey. Drawing perspective and aperture definitions remain uncertain.
priorities.action: Add stepped/flared keystone and curled side shoulders. Widen surrounds, not the reported central aperture.

priorities.observed: Three arches spring from slender round shafts with broad flared capitals and bases. Outer square pilasters frame arcade; angular relief panels occupy spandrels. Dark passages differ from office-window grids.
priorities.metric_limit: Shaft/aperture pixel ratio under current reconstructed2.5m portal width.
priorities.action: Keep real arched voids; add cylindrical shafts, caps and bases; avoid prominent bright horizontal office-window rails across passages.

priorities.observed: Center bay has a projecting balcony-like base with solid end piers and short balustrade. It breaks the continuous first-story belt.
priorities.action: Add center-bay platform/base and restrained balusters below current upper sill.

priorities.observed: Four smaller north oculi have projecting molded casings with side/hood depth. Upper roof edge has a layered continuous molding and small repeating blocks.
priorities.action: Connect casings back to roof; add layered crest/dentils; avoid floating rings or clipping.

priorities.observed: Several lower office windows show paired vertical lights and a rounded upper light related to the upper-flank pattern.
priorities.action: After silhouette corrections, add restrained two-light/upper-circle sash to office windows; preserve dark entrances as separate types.
